description: Laboratory and field performance of a bamboo-drip irrigation system, Benin, 2014-2016 is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by bonndata. The file was developed to assess the performance of a novel bamboo-drip irrigation system in laboratory and in field conditions, in South-west Benin. The assessment was conducted in terms of hydraulics, uniformity, yield, water productivity and soil-water management. Coverage: Benin. The portal files it under the publisher bonndata. Its tags are Other, yield (agricultural), agriculture, trickle irrigation, water supply. The repository dates the deposit 2023; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Share Alike 4.0 International. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support irrigation network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
